requirements: lineTotal in basket.mjs returns the line's price times its quantity, so two mugs at 12.50 give a line total of 25.00.
A line with no quantity counts as a quantity of one in lineTotal.
basketTotal returns the sum of the lineTotal of every line.
An empty basket totals 0 in basketTotal.
Prices are in cents, so lineTotal and basketTotal take and return whole cents.

requirements: withRetry(fn, times) in retry.mjs calls fn until one call succeeds and gives back what that call gave.
withRetry makes at most times calls to fn in all.
After a call succeeds, withRetry does not call fn again.
When every call fails, withRetry throws the error of the last call.
When times is 1, withRetry makes one call to fn and does not retry.
When the stock service drops a request, the failed request is tried again and the page does not show an error at once.
